    }
    trigger = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
    immediate = { oe_ml_take_as = { line = 32 } }
    option = {
        name = oe_l7.23.a
        trigger = { var:oe_l7_tre ?= 1 }
        ai_chance = { base = 100 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_l7.23.b
        trigger = { NOT = { var:oe_l7_tre ?= 1 } }
        ai_chance = { base = 100 }
    }
}

# Hidden worker, fired from the options (var oe_l7_job): the roll, the handover and the death stay out of the option
# previews. Jobs: 1 the roll (.3 a); 11 the gates opened (.3 b); 12 the emperor's death (.4 f a); 21 peace bought (.3 c);
# 22 the tribute agreement (.10 c, .11 a); 23 the truce for a tribute paid (.12 a).
# 30 the roll for the Morea (.13 a); 31 the Morea given up (.13 c); 40 the ships for Trebizond (.20 a); 41 money (.20 b).
# 50-54, 58-59: phase 4 exile revival (.50-.55, BYZ / TRE / FEO).
oe_l7.90 = {
    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    title = oe_l7.90.t
    trigger = { oe_l7_ex_tag_ok = yes }
    immediate = {
        if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_job ?= 1 } oe_l7_job_1 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_job ?= 11 } oe_l7_job_11 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_job ?= 12 } oe_l7_job_12 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_job ?= 21 } oe_l7_job_21 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_job ?= 22 } oe_l7_job_22 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_job ?= 23 } oe_l7_job_23 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_job ?= 30 } oe_l7_job_30 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_job ?= 31 } oe_l7_job_31 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_job ?= 40 } oe_l7_job_40 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_job ?= 41 } oe_l7_job_41 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_job ?= 50 } oe_l7_job_50 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_job ?= 51 } oe_l7_job_51 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_job ?= 52 } oe_l7_job_52 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_job ?= 53 } oe_l7_job_53 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_job ?= 54 } oe_l7_job_54 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_job ?= 58 } oe_l7_job_58 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_l7_job ?= 59 } oe_l7_job_59 = yes }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l7_job } remove_variable = oe_l7_job }
    }
}
